scope: Input and model already resident in host memory -> complete output resident in host memory. File IO, correctness comparison, compilation and initial overlay loading excluded.
limitations: Functional memory-to-memory boundaries, not identical internal operations. CPU is a scalar reference baseline, not an optimized NEON/multithreaded library. CPU/FPGA were measured sequentially, not concurrently; CPU clock and thermal state were not controlled. No isolated kernel/model/DMA timing is claimed.
notebook: Original error and successful retry records preserved unchanged.
